correctness.rationale: For any \(v\), each neighbor \(w\) has two distinct triangle-completing vertices in \(N[v]\), so every vertex of the induced \(G[N[v]]\) has degree at least three and none is removable. If \(\deg(v)\le n-1\), then \(|N[v]|\le n\), contradicting \(\psi_n\); hence \(\delta(G)\ge n\). Thus \(V\ge n+1\), \(E\ge nV/2\), and \(E\le3V-6+6g\) gives \(g\ge1+\lceil(n-6)(n+1)/12\rceil\).
residual_risks: Orientable genus only; the bound is not claimed sharp.
